newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel sells Discount Bank stake.
newsitem.headline: Israel sells Discount Bank stake.

text.p: Israel's offering of Israel Discount Bank shares and warrants was three times oversubscribed and the price closed on Monday at nine percent above the minimum, underwriter IBI Investment said.

The price closed at 170 shekels for a package of five shares, nine Series Two warrants (part of which are exercisable now and the rest in July) and seven Series Three warrants (exercisable in November). The minimum price had been set at 156 shekels.
The government expects to raise 621 million shekels from the sale of a 17 percent stake in Israel's third largest commercial bank.
